messages:
rebecca: Quick QA on the rollout legend / variant key — two small things from crit: legend readability in compact mode, and patterned fallback for colorblind readers. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/legend/rollout-legend (mock). Thoughts?
sam: I noticed legend items wrap weirdly at narrow widths. Proposal: collapse into a single-line overflow with a "More" chevron that expands a popover. Keeps timeline height stable.
tara: +1. For pattern fallback we should use a subtle diagonal hatch + a small icon (square/circle) per variant. That way color + shape convey variant. Also add an optional "pattern only" contrast toggle in A11y settings.
jules: Copy nit: current legend labels like "canary (B)" are vague. Recommend full form: "Variant B — canary (35%)". Primary info first (variant name), then role, then allocation. Shortens scanning.
a11y-bot: Accessibility checklist: legend items must be keyboard focusable and announce name + percentage via aria-label, e.g. aria-label="Variant B, canary, 35 percent". Patterns count as non-text contrast; aim for 3:1 against background. Also expose a high-contrast legend mode.
sam: Behaviour note: when a user toggles a variant in the legend (show/hide), announce via live region: "Variant B hidden from timeline". Use aria-live="polite".
jules: Tooltip format suggestion: show three lines: Variant name, allocation (localized percent), and last snapshot timestamp (short). Example: "Variant B\n35% (~3.5k rps)\nMar 24, 09:12 local". Keyboard users should be able to open tooltip with Enter or Space.
a11y-bot: Motion note: legend expand/collapse animations must respect prefers-reduced-motion. Provide instant expand when reduced-motion is set. Also ensure focus isn't shifted during toggle.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: legend-toggle event recorded user=sam variant=B ts=2005001260
tara: Visual detail: add a 1px stroke around pattern chips to keep separation on dark themes. For very small chips (<12px) switch to a solid icon rather than detailed hatch so it stays legible.
rebecca: Good list. Action items: Sam to spec popover + live region text, Tara to export pattern set + high-contrast assets, Jules to update legend copy and tooltip microcopy, A11y-bot to publish ARIA snippets. We'll validate in the next design crit. Thanks!
